t: You're on Bedford Gardens, a street in Kensington that runs west to east, from Campden Hill Road down to Kensington Church Street. Thomas Winterbottom, who served as Lord Mayor of London and died in 1752, is recorded as having lived on this street. That's a nice link between this quiet residential corner of Kensington and the city's civic leadership, and it tells you people of standing have been living here for a very long time. Take a look at the houses as you go along.
